_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: System/Segment Interface Control Specification
summary: Defines the physical and functional interface and parameter requirements between interconnecting, interacting, or co-functioning systems, system segments, and assemblies as a top level control document.
use_relationship:
The interface control specification defines the physical and functional interface, parameter requirements between interconnecting, interacting, or co-functioning systems, system segments, and assemblies. It is used as a top level control document governing the design of the interfacing elements of the system/segment.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID is applicable to systems and equipment development contracts involving hardware-to-hardware and hardware-to-external factors (facilities, mission elements, etc), interface conditions. For hardware-to-software or software-to-software cases, DI-CMAN-81248A, Interface Control Document, DI-IPSC-81434A, Interface Requirement Specification, or DI-IPSC-81436A, Interface Design Description shall be used.

When the complete interface requirements shall be reflected on an interface control drawing and installation drawing as described in DOD-STD-100C, use DI-SESS-81000C, Product Drawings and associated lists.

This DID supersedes DI-CMAN-81314.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the current issue of the DODISS at the time of the solicitation; for non DODISS-listed documents, as stated herein.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The interface specification shall be prepared on 8 1/2 x 11" paper (metric size A4). It may be prepared as a multi-part, book form document as appropriate to the complexity of the interface(s) to be defined. It shall contain the following (see figure 1 for an outline of the specification structure and paragraphing):

children.title: Front cover/title page
children.content: The cover and title page shall contain the following:

children.title: Specification number
children.content: The expression "SPECIFICATION NUMBER" (all capital letters) followed by the assigned specification number shall appear in the upper right corner.

children.title: Date
children.content: The expression "DATE" (all capital letters) followed by the issue date of the specification (day, month, year) shall appear directly under the specification number in the upper right corner.

children.title: Title
children.content: The title shall be a multi-line entry centered in the middle of the cover on title page as follows:

children.title: The first two lines shall read (all capital letters)
children.content: INTERFACE CONTROL SPECIFICATION FOR

children.title: The third and subsequent lines shall include
The nomenclature of only the primary system, segment or configuration item
children.content: The nomenclature of only the primary system, segment or configuration item (including name and type designation and configuration item number) when more than one interfacing item is involved, or

children.title: The nomenclature of each interfacing system, segment, or configuration item
children.content: The nomenclature of each interfacing system, segment, or configuration item (including name, and type designation and configuration item number) where only two items are interfacing.

children.title: Approval certification
children.content: Approval certifications shall be entered on the title. Name, signature and approval date shall be included as identified by the government.

children.title: Section 1.0. Scope.
children.content: The scope shall include:

children.title: System/segment interface identification
children.content: This section shall briefly describe the overall system, segment, or equipment to be addressed by the interface specification. It shall include a matrix diagram identifying each interfacing item, and show the origin and destination of each interface.

children.title: Documentation organization
children.content: This section shall describe the manner in which the specification is structured, and provides guidance on its use.

children.title: Limitations and restrictions
children.content: This section shall describe any limitations or restrictions to the use of the specification.

children.title: Section 2.0 Applicable documents.
children.content: All documents having a bearing on the system and segment interfaces shall be identified in sub-sections by the title number, and applicable data. This shall include:

children.title: Military and Federal specifications, standards, and handbooks.
Interface control documentation
children.content: This includes all related or referenced interface control drawings and interface control specifications.

children.title: Other documentation
children.content: This includes any applicable industry or other documentation.

children.title: Section 3.0, Interface requirements.
children.content: This section provides the detailed description of the interface requirements. Each interface shall be separately covered in its own subsection (see figure 1), and include:

children.title: Functional interface specification details by parameter.
Physical interface specification details by parameter.
Section 4.0, Quality assurance.
children.content: This section shall identify and define the inspection and test requirements necessary to verify the designed end product complies with the interface requirements of section 3.0.

children.title: Section 5.0, Notes.
children.content: This section shall include non-binding administration information such as supersession data or other clarifying information. Each independent subject area shall be in a separate sub-section.

children.title: Physical interface parameters
children.content: These shall relate to the physical mating of systems, segments, and assemblies at a common boundary. Applicable interface control drawings (ICD) and installation drawings shall be referenced or reproduced as appropriate. Physical interface parameters elements shall include:

children.title: Dimensions and tolerances of mating surface
children.content: Dimensions and tolerances of mating surface (flanges, boltholes, mounting plates, etc., with applicable sizes, shapes, and spacing).

children.title: Weight, balance, and center of gravity.
Sealing requirements, leakage prevention and detection.
